purpose: Independent reproduction of the frozen training-only calibration, before and after defect remediation.
preservation: output/calibration/frozen_manifest.json was never modified; it remains the version-1 historical artifact.

v0_vs_v1.interpretation: The frozen calibration reproduces bit-for-bit from the unmodified code. Sampling, partitioning, all 32 proposed trials and all 6 baseline trials are deterministic.

v1_vs_v2.interpretation: Defect remediation changed no calibration result. The corpus-cache refactor reorders iteration only; every (example, configuration) evaluation is independent given the corpus.

memory_policy_change.v1: every sampled corpus retained for the whole search (both index families)

v2.policy: one active corpus; resident indexes do not grow with sample size
v2.note: a corpus repeated non-adjacently in sample order is rebuilt; results are unaffected because each (example, configuration) evaluation is independent given the corpus

memory_policy_change.note: 60 builds vs 58 unique corpora: two corpora recur non-adjacently in sample order and are rebuilt. Results unaffected.

realized_partition.cause: round(5 * 0.30) = 2 under banker rounding, so each 5-example stratum yields 3 tuning and 2 selection.

selection_rule.documented: Shortlist configurations within 0.01 of best TUNING gold-evidence recall, then on the held-back selection partition maximize complete-evidence recovery, then evidence precision, then minimize context tokens, then candidates examined, then serialized parameter order.
selection_rule.implemented: Identical, except that choose_configuration re-filters the shortlist to configurations within 0.01 of the best SELECTION-partition recall before applying the lexicographic order.
selection_rule.effect_on_v1: None observed: the selected configuration is unchanged under either reading of the rule for this sample.
selection_rule.recommendation: Adopt the IMPLEMENTED rule as the version-2 documented rule and state it explicitly.
selection_rule.justification: The extra filter is strictly more recall-protective. Removing it would let a configuration with materially lower held-back recall win on complete-evidence ties, which contradicts the stated priority that evidence coverage outranks efficiency. Changing code after results exist is also the more dangerous edit; correcting prose is not.

status: Version 1 calibration is reproducible and remains valid. No re-freeze is required.
